Want more Google reviews for your restaurant? Here's what actually works 👇

📌 Grab your review link in your Google Business Profile, under "Ask for reviews"
📌 One tap opens the review form, no searching on Maps
📌 Put the link in a QR code on every table and on the bill
📌 Ask in person, right when guests say they loved the meal
📌 Reply to every review, good or bad, so people see someone's listening
📌 Never offer discounts for reviews: Google's rules forbid it

Follow for more restaurant tips.

Why does a menu in your guests' language sell more? 👇

📌 A guest who can't read the menu plays it safe and orders the one dish they recognise
📌 Your specials and the wine you're proud of stay unordered
📌 In their own language, guests explore the whole menu
📌 Printed translations cost money and go stale when dishes change
📌 A digital menu opens in the guest's phone language after one QR scan
📌 The kitchen still gets the order in your language, so nothing gets lost in translation

Follow for more restaurant tips.

Save this for when you plan your menu languages, and send it to a restaurant owner with international guests 📌

Want a QR code menu for your restaurant? Here are the 5 steps 👇

1️⃣ Build your menu in the dashboard
2️⃣ Tag the allergens on every dish (the EU lists 14)
3️⃣ Add languages: 6 are supported, and automatic translation does the first draft
4️⃣ Download the table cards as one ZIP and print them (QR code, table number and PIN)
5️⃣ Open the kitchen screen on a tablet: orders land there, not on paper

🎁 Launch offer for new customers: use code ACMEFREE-BASE, ACMEFREE-PREMIUM or ACMEFREE-ENTERPRISE (matching your plan) at checkout and your first month is on us. Valid until 30 November.
Try it free for 14 days → acme.example (link in bio)
